## Initialize SDK [![github]({{ githubIcon }})](https://github.com/openai/openai-python)

AITable's chat completion API is compatible with OpenAI's Python SDK. You can use our service with the same SDK by simply changing the configuration as follows:

```python
import openai
# Setup parameters
openai.api_key = "{{token}}"
openai.api_base = "{{apiBase}}/fusion/v1/ai/{{aiId}}"
```

## Create chat completions

```python
chat_completion = openai.ChatCompletion.create(model="gpt-3.5-turbo", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello world"}])
```

## Get records

```shell
curl "{{ apiBase }}/fusion/v1/datasheets/{{ datasheetId }}/records?viewId={{ viewId }}&fieldKey={{ fieldKey }}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{ apiToken }}"

```

### Returned data example

```json
{{ response }}

```

### Other parameters and tips
```js
/**
* Note: The maximum concurrent access to data for each APITable is limited to 5 times per second
* All configurable parameters can be sent through URL Query Params,
*/
{
  /**
   * (Optional) View ID. Defaults to the first view in the APITable. The request will return the filtered/sorted results in the view, and you can use the fields parameter to filter unnecessary field data
   */
  viewId: 'viewId1',
  /**
   * (Optional) Specifies the page number of the pagination, which is 1 by default and is used in conjunction with the parameter pageSize.
   */
  pageNum: 1,
  /**
   * (Optional) Specify the total number of records returned per page, default is 100. This parameter only accepts integers from 1-1000.
   */
  pageSize: 100,
  /**
   * (Optional) Sorts the records of the specified dimensional table. An array of "sort objects". Supported order: 'asc' and reverse order: 'desc'. Note: The sorting criteria specified by this parameter will override the sorting criteria in the view.
   */
  sort: [{ field: 'field1', order: 'asc' }],
  /**
   * (Optional) An array of recordIds. If this parameter is attached, returns the records array specified in the parameter. The return values are sorted in the order of the passed array. Filtering and sorting are ignored at this time. No pagination, up to 1000 records can be queried each time
   */
  recordIds: ['recordId1', 'recordId2'],
  /**
   * (Optional) Specify the field to return (the default is the field name, and it can also be specified as the field Id by fieldKey). If this parameter is attached, the returned record collection will be filtered, and only the specified fields will be returned.
   */
  fields: ['title', 'detail', 'Number of references'],
  /**

  /**

  maxRecords: 5000,

  cellFormat: 'json',

   */
  fieldKey: 'name',
}
```

<!--split-->

## Add records
```shell
curl -X POST "{{ apiBase }}/fusion/v1/datasheets/{{ datasheetId }}/records?viewId={{ viewId }}&fieldKey={{ fieldKey }}"  \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{ apiToken }}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{
  "records": {{ records }},
  "fieldKey": "{{ fieldKey }}"
}'

```

### Returned data example

```json
{{ response }}
```

### Other parameters and tips

The add interface receives an array value, and can create multiple records at the same time, and a single request can create up to 10 records

<!--split-->

## Update records
```shell
curl -X PATCH "{{ apiBase }}/fusion/v1/datasheets/{{ datasheetId }}/records?viewId={{ viewId }}&fieldKey={{ fieldKey }}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{ apiToken }}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{
  "records": {{ records }},
  "fieldKey": "{{ fieldKey }}"
}'
```
### Returned data example

```json
{{ response }}
```


### Other parameters and tips

The update interface receives an array value, which can update multiple records at the same time, and a single request can update up to 10 records
Special attention: update will only update the data under the fields you passed in, and will not affect the data that is not passed in. If you need to clear the value, please pass in null explicitly


<!--split-->

## Delete records
```shell
curl -X DELETE "{{ apiBase }}/fusion/v1/datasheets/{{ datasheetId }}/records?{{ deleteParams }}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{ apiToken }}"

```

### Returned data example
```json
{
  "code": 200,
  "success": true,
  "message": "success"
}
```

### Other parameters and tips

The delete interface receives an array value, which can delete multiple records at the same time, and a single request can delete up to 10 records

## Upload attachments

```shell
curl -X POST "{{ apiBase }}/fusion/v1/datasheets/{{ datasheetId }}/attachments" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{ apiToken }}" \
  -H "Content-Type: multipart/form-data" \
  -F "file=@{your file path};"
```

## Initialize SDK [![github]({{ githubIcon }})](https://github.com/apitable/apitable-sdks)

```python
from apitable import Apitable
apitable = Apitable("{{ apiToken }}")
datasheet = apitable.datasheet("{{ datasheetId }}", field_key="{{ fieldKey }}")
```

{{ fieldNameTips }}
<!--split-->

## Get records

```python
# Returns all records
records = datasheet.records.all()
for record in records:
  print(record.json())

# Returns the records from a specific view
records_via_view = datasheet.records.all(viewId="{{ viewId }}")
# Get one record (if there are more than one records in the result, return the first record); It's recommended to get one record by its recordId.
one_record = datasheet.records.get({{ pyGetParams }})
# Returns the records that matches the given condition. If you don't give any condition, it returns all records.
records = datasheet.records.filter({{ pyGetParams }})
```
<!--split-->

## Add records
```python
# Add one record
row = datasheet.records.create({{ addParams }})
# Add multiple records
records = datasheet.records.bulk_create({{  bulkAddParams }})

```
<!--split-->

## Update records
```python
row = datasheet.records.get({{ pyGetParams }})

# Update one record
row.{{ oneFieldKey }} = {{ oneFieldValue }}
```

Die Spiegelfunktion bietet die Möglichkeit, bestimmte Daten auszublenden. Sie können in der ursprünglichen Datenblattansicht „Filterbedingungen“ und „ausgeblendete Felder“ festlegen, um zu steuern, welche Datensätze und Felder im Spiegel angezeigt werden.
</br>
</br>
In Verbindung mit der Funktion „Ansichtssperre“ kann sie andere daran hindern, Änderungen vorzunehmen.
</br>
</br>
Darüber hinaus können Sie zu „Originaltabelle > Ausgeblendete Felder“ gehen, um die Konfiguration für „Alle Felder in Spiegeln anzeigen“ zu ändern.

After installing the integration, please complete the space bundle, and after bundling, your team can use Vikadata on DingTalk.

With Vikadata Assistant on DingTalk, you can:

  • Receive notifications from the space through DingTalk;
  • Set app visibility on DingTalk and automatically sync DingTalk's organization structure;

de-DE.function_countif_summary:
Count the number of keyword occurrences in values. 

Values: specify where to find the data from. Supports data of array type or text type. 
Keyword: the keyword to be looked up and counted. 
Operation: comparator, not required. You can fill in the condition symbols greater than ">", less than "<", equal to "=", not equal to "! =", if not filled in the default is equal to. 
Example 1 does not fill in the comparison character, the default count is equal to the number of times the value of "A" appears. 
Example 2 is filled with the comparator ">", which means that the number of occurrences of values greater than "2" is counted. 

Usage scenarios. 
1) You can count the number of occurrences of the character "A" in a string of text arrays [A, B, C, D, A] as 2, see example 1. 
2) You can count the number of numbers greater than 3 in an array of numbers [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] as 2, see example 2. 
3) You can count the number of occurrences of "grape" in a string of text "eat grapes without spitting out the skin" as 2, see example 3.

Replaces occurrences of old_text with new_text.

de-DE.function_sum_summary: Summen Sie die Zahlen zusammen. Äquivalent zu nummer1.nummer2 +...

WEEKDAY(TODAY(), "Monday")

de-DE.function_workday_summary:
Returns a date several workdays after the start date.

[startDate] is the start date you specify.
[numDays] is the number of workdays after the start date you specify, expressed as a positive number. For example, the number "1" represents a date one workday after the start date;
[holidays] Is not required. It is specific dates that you want to remove from your calendar, such as a holiday. The input format is "yyyy-mm-dd", and multiple dates are separated by commas.

The workdays of this function do not include weekends and specific days that you specify.

After installing the integration, please complete the space bundle, and after bundling, your team can use Vikadata on Lark.

With Vikadata Assistant on Lark, you can:

  • Access Vikadata's space and access space data directly on Lark without logging in;

  • Set app visibility on Lark and automatically sync Lark's organization structure;

de-DE.lark_integration_step1_content:
• Bind the current space to Lark, the original data can be retained intact
  • Access the vikadata space directly from the Lark Workbench to enable password-free login and access to space data
  • Receive member notifications and comment notifications from vikadata right on Lark to stay on top of space developments
  • Lark and vikadata dual-site contacts are automatically updated/synchronized, and vikadata maintains the same organizational structure as Lark
de-DE.lark_integration_step1_instructions: vikadata x Lark Self-Built Application Integration Anleitung
de-DE.lark_integration_step1_tips_content: • In addition to the build-your-own app approach, we also offer a version of the Lark Store app that is ready to use right out of the box without configuration and binding to the space What's different?
de-DE.lark_integration_step1_warning:
• Operators must have administrative access to both vikadata space and Lark

    The operator needs to be the main administrator of the space and also have the permission to create self-built applications in the Lark administration backend

  • The original members of the space will be removed from the space station, and then the member information and department information will be synchronized from the Lark side in one direction

    After Lark integration is enabled, member and department information will be based on the Lark side, so the original member/group information cannot be retained, and related permission information (sub-administrator permission, file permission, column permission, etc.) will be lost, so please let administrators know and make preparations

de-DE.office_preview_app_desc:
Smooth online preview of office files on datasheet, allowing you to view common office files such as Excel, Word, PPT, etc. on your desktop or mobile anywhere, anytime

  • Online preview of .doc, .docx, .xls, .xlsx, .ppt, .pptx, and .pdf formatted office files
  • Desktop and mobile both support file previews of the above formats

Additional notes:

  • This feature is powered by "Yoncentric Cloud Conversion" and officially integrated
  • Click the "Enable" button below to enable this integration and agree that "Yoncentric Cloud Conversion" reads the office files you want to preview
  • If you no longer need the office files preview feature, the space admin can disable it on this page

de-DE.test_function_modal_info_robot:
Vika Automation ist der Wächter für Ihre Arbeitseffizienz auf dem Vika-Planeten. Der Mensch soll kreativere Dinge tun! Dokumentation ansehen

Beispielautomatisierungen:

  • Automatisierung Alpha: Wenn ein Datensatz erstellt wird, sendet Alpha automatisch eine Nachricht an den Slack-Kanal
  • Automatisierung Beta: Wenn ein bestimmtes Formular übermittelt wird, sendet Beta automatisch eine Nachricht an die Lark-Chat-Gruppe
  • Automatisierungsdelta: Wenn ein Datensatz eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt, aktualisiert Delta automatisch einen anderen Datensatz in einem anderen Datenblatt
de-DE.test_function_modal_info_view_manual_sav:
Conflicts often arise when members modify filtering, grouping, or sorting in the same view, as each wants to configure it to suit their needs. After enabling this feature, temporary view configuration is supported in "Datasheet" and "Mirror" to reduce conflicts.

After this feature is enabled, it affects:

  • After members in "View" modify the view configuration, it will only take effect temporarily for themselves. After refreshing, the default configuration will be restored. Members can choose to manually save the view configuration and sync it to other members
  • Temporary view configurations are also supported on Mirror. Special case: The filter conditions of the source datasheet view cannot be modified in the mirror
  • Users with "read-only" permission are also allowed to temporarily modify the view configuration.
  • View configuration includes: filter, group, sort, hide fields, style, layout, field order, statistics, etc.
de-DE.test_function_modal_info_widget:
Als vikadata ist im Wesentlichen eine visualisierte Datenbank, das Widget-ist der beste Helfer, um die Datenbank schnell in verschiedene Anwendungen. Jetzt unterstützt vikadata benutzerdefinierte Widgets, die es Entwicklern ermöglichen, Widget-SDK vollständig zu nutzen, um Geschäftsszenarien und persönliche Bedürfnisse zu erfüllen. ​

< p > Beispiele für benutzerdefinierte Widgets:

Zellbetrachter: ermöglicht das einfache durchsuchen von Daten aus verschiedenen Spaltenarten, wie Einweg-, Zwei-Wege-Verknüpfung, Lookup und Anhänge

Vika-Karte: hilft Ihnen, die Adresse schnell aus einem Datenbuch in einer Google-Karte zu rendern

​

## Get records

```shell
curl "{{ apiBase }}/fusion/v1/datasheets/{{ datasheetId }}/records?viewId={{ viewId }}&fieldKey={{ fieldKey }}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{ apiToken }}"

```

### Returned data example

```json

{{ response }}

```

### Other parameters and tips
```js
/**
* Note: The maximum concurrent access to data for each APITable is limited to 5 times per second
* All configurable parameters can be sent through URL Query Params,
*/
{
  /**
   * (Optional) View ID. Defaults to the first view in the APITable. The request will return the filtered/sorted results in the view, and you can use the fields parameter to filter unnecessary field data
   */
  viewId: 'viewId1',
  /**
   * (Optional) Specifies the page number of the pagination, which is 1 by default and is used in conjunction with the parameter pageSize.
   */
  pageNum: 1,
  /**
   * (Optional) Specify the total number of records returned per page, default is 100. This parameter only accepts integers from 1-1000.
   */
  pageSize: 100,
  /**
   * (Optional) Sorts the records of the specified dimensional table. An array of "sort objects". Supported order: 'asc' and reverse order: 'desc'. Note: The sorting criteria specified by this parameter will override the sorting criteria in the view.
   */
  sort: [{ field: 'field1', order: 'asc' }],
  /**
   * (Optional) An array of recordIds. If this parameter is attached, returns the records array specified in the parameter. The return values are sorted in the order of the passed array. Filtering and sorting are ignored at this time. No pagination, up to 1000 records can be queried each time
   */
  recordIds: ['recordId1', 'recordId2'],
  /**
   * (Optional) Specify the field to return (the default is the field name, and it can also be specified as the field Id by fieldKey). If this parameter is attached, the returned record collection will be filtered, and only the specified fields will be returned.
   */
  fields: ['title', 'detail', 'Number of references'],
  /**
   * (Optional) Use formulas as filter conditions to return matching records. Visit https://help.aitable.ai/docs/guide/tutorial-getting-started-with-formulas to learn how to use formulas
   */
  filterByFormula: '{Number of references} >  0',
  /**
   * (Optional) Limit the total number of records returned. If this value is less than the actual total number of records in the table, the total number of records returned will be limited to this value.
   */
  maxRecords: 5000,
  /**
   * (Optional) Cell value type, the default is 'json', when 'string' is specified, all values will be automatically converted to string format.
   */
  cellFormat: 'json',
  /**
   * (Optional) Specifies the query of the field and the returned key. By default the column name 'name' is used. When specified as 'id', fieldId will be used as the query and return method (using id can avoid the problem of code failure caused by the modification of the column name)
   */
  fieldKey: 'name',
}
```

<!--split-->

## Add records
```shell
curl -X POST "{{ apiBase }}/fusion/v1/datasheets/{{ datasheetId }}/records?viewId={{ viewId }}&fieldKey={{ fieldKey }}"  \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{ apiToken }}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{
  "records": {{ records }},
  "fieldKey": "{{ fieldKey }}"
}'

```

### Returned data example

```json
{{ response }}
```

### Other parameters and tips

The add interface receives an array value, and can create multiple records at the same time, and a single request can create up to 10 records

<!--split-->

## Update records
```shell
curl -X PATCH "{{ apiBase }}/fusion/v1/datasheets/{{ datasheetId }}/records?viewId={{ viewId }}&fieldKey={{ fieldKey }}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{ apiToken }}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{
  "records": {{ records }},
  "fieldKey": "{{ fieldKey }}"
}'
```
### Returned data example

```json
{{ response }}
```


### Other parameters and tips

The update interface receives an array value, which can update multiple records at the same time, and a single request can update up to 10 records
Special attention: update will only update the data under the fields you passed in, and will not affect the data that is not passed in. If you need to clear the value, please pass in null explicitly

```shell
curl -X DELETE "{{ apiBase }}/fusion/v1/datasheets/{{ datasheetId }}/records?{{ deleteParams }}" \
```

```json
}
```

## Initialize SDK [![github]({{ githubIcon }})](https://github.com/apitable/apitable-sdks)

```python
from apitable import Apitable
apitable = Apitable("{{ apiToken }}")
datasheet = apitable.datasheet("{{ datasheetId }}", field_key="{{ fieldKey }}")
```

{{ fieldNameTips }}
<!--split-->

## Get records

```python
# Returns all records
records = datasheet.records.all()
for record in records:
  print(record.json())

# Returns the records from a specific view
records_via_view = datasheet.records.all(viewId="{{ viewId }}")
# Get one record (if there are more than one records in the result, return the first record); It's recommended to get one record by its recordId.
one_record = datasheet.records.get({{ pyGetParams }})
# Returns the records that matches the given condition. If you don't give any condition, it returns all records.
records = datasheet.records.filter({{ pyGetParams }})
```
<!--split-->

## Add records
```python
# Add one record
row = datasheet.records.create({{ addParams }})
# Add multiple records
records = datasheet.records.bulk_create({{  bulkAddParams }})

```
<!--split-->

## Update records
```python
row = datasheet.records.get({{ pyGetParams }})

# Update one record
row.{{ oneFieldKey }} = {{ oneFieldValue }}
## row.save()

# Update multiple records
row.update({{ updateParams }})

```
<!--split-->

## Delete records
```python
record = datasheet.records.get({{ pyGetParams }})
# Delete one record
record.delete()
# Delete the records that matches a specific condition
datasheet.records.filter({{ pyGetParams }}).delete()
# Delete the records by recordIds
datasheet.delete_records({{ recordIds }})
```
<!--split-->

## Upload attachments

```python
_file = datasheet.upload_file(<local/web_filepath>)
record.{{ attachFieldName }} = [_file]
```

Joins together the text arguments into a single text value. To concatenate static text, surround it with double quotation marks. To concatenate double quotation marks, you need to use a backslash (\) as an escape character.
Equivalent to using the & operator.

en-US.function_countif_summary:
Count the number of keyword occurrences in values. 

Values: specify where to find the data from. Supports data of array type or text type. 
Keyword: the keyword to be looked up and counted. 
Operation: comparator, not required. You can fill in the condition symbols greater than ">", less than "<", equal to "=", not equal to "! =", if not filled in the default is equal to. 
Example 1 does not fill in the comparison character, the default count is equal to the number of times the value of "A" appears. 
Example 2 is filled with the comparator ">", which means that the number of occurrences of values greater than "2" is counted. 

Usage scenarios. 
1) You can count the number of occurrences of the character "A" in a string of text arrays [A, B, C, D, A] as 2, see example 1. 
2) You can count the number of numbers greater than 3 in an array of numbers [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] as 2, see example 2. 
3) You can count the number of occurrences of "grape" in a string of text "eat grapes without spitting out the skin" as 2, see example 3.

en-US.function_min_summary: Returns the smallest of the given numbers.
en-US.function_minute_summary: Returns the minute of a datetime as an integer between 0 and 59.
en-US.function_mod_summary: Returns the remainder after dividing the first argument by the second.
en-US.function_month_summary: Returns the month of a datetime as a number between 1 (January) and 12 (December).
en-US.function_not_summary: Reverses the logical value of its argument.
en-US.function_now_summary: Returns the current date and time.
en-US.function_odd_summary: Rounds positive value up to the nearest odd number and negative value down to the nearest odd number.
en-US.function_or_summary: Returns true if any one of the arguments is true.
en-US.function_power_summary: Computes the specified base to the specified power.
en-US.function_quarter_summary: Returns the quater of a datetime as a number between 1  and 4.
en-US.function_record_id_summary: Returns the ID of the current record.
en-US.function_replace_example:
REPLACE("This is an apple", 12, 8, "elephant")
=> This is an elephant
en-US.function_replace_summary:
Replaces the number of characters beginning with the start character with the replacement text.
(If you're looking for a way to find and replace all occurrences of old_text with new_text, see SUBSTITUTE().)
en-US.function_rept_summary: Repeats string by the specified number of times.
en-US.function_right_summary: Extract howMany characters from the end of the string.
en-US.function_round_summary: Rounds the value to the number of decimal places given by "precision." (Specifically, ROUND will round to the nearest integer at the specified precision, with ties broken by rounding half up toward positive infinity.)
en-US.function_rounddown_summary: Rounds the value to the number of decimal places given by "precision," always rounding down, i.e., toward zero. (You must give a value for the precision or the function will not work.)
en-US.function_roundup_summary: Rounds the value to the number of decimal places given by "precision," always rounding up, i.e., away from zero. (You must give a value for the precision or the function will not work.)
en-US.function_search_summary:
Searches for an occurrence of stringToFind in whereToSearch string starting from an optional startFromPosition. (startFromPosition is 0 by default.) If no occurrence of stringToFind is found, the result will be empty.
Similar to FIND(), though FIND() returns 0 rather than empty if no occurrence of stringToFind is found.
en-US.function_second_summary: Returns the second of a datetime as an integer between 0 and 59.
en-US.function_set_locale_summary: Sets a specific locale for a datetime. Must be used in conjunction with DATETIME_FORMAT.
en-US.function_set_timezone_summary: Sets a specific timezone for a datetime. Must be used in conjunction with DATETIME_FORMAT.
en-US.function_sqrt_summary: Returns the square root of a nonnegative number.
en-US.function_substitute_example:
SUBSTITUTE("gold mold", "old", "et")
=> get met

SUBSTITUTE("gold mold", "old", "et", 1)
=> get mold
en-US.function_substitute_summary:
Replaces occurrences of old_text with new_text.
You can optionally specify an index number (starting from 1) to replace just a specific occurrence of old_text. If no index number is specified, then all occurrences of old_text will be replaced.
en-US.function_sum_summary: Sum together the numbers. Equivalent to number1 + number2 + ...
en-US.function_switch_summary: Takes an expression, a list of possible values for that expression, and for each one, a value that the expression should take in that case. It can also take a default value if the expression input doesn't match any of the defined patterns. In many cases, SWITCH() can be used instead of a nested IF() formula.
en-US.function_t_summary: Returns the argument if it is text and blank otherwise.
en-US.function_timestr_summary: Formats a datetime into a time-only string (HH:mm:ss).
en-US.function_today_summary:
Returns today's date (year, month, and day), but is not precise to hours, minutes, and seconds (default is 00:00:00). If you want to be precise to the hours, minutes, and seconds, use the function NOW.

Note: The results returned by this function are updated only when the calculation formula is refreshed or the datasheet is refreshed.
en-US.function_tonow_summary: Calculates the number of days between the current date and another date.
en-US.function_trim_summary: Removes whitespace at the beginning and end of the string.
en-US.function_value_summary: Converts the text string to a number.
en-US.function_weekday_summary:
Returns the day of the week as an integer between 0 and 6, inclusive. You may optionally provide a second argument (either "Sunday" or "Monday") to start weeks on that day. If omitted, weeks start on Sunday by default. Example:
WEEKDAY(TODAY(), "Monday")
en-US.function_weeknum_summary:
Returns the week number in a year. You may optionally provide a second argument (either "Sunday" or "Monday") to start weeks on that day. If omitted, weeks start on Sunday by default. Example:
WEEKNUM(TODAY(), "Monday")
en-US.function_workday_diff_summary: Returns the number of working days between startDate and endDate. Working days exclude weekends and an optional list of holidays, formatted as a comma-separated string of ISO-formatted dates.
en-US.function_workday_summary:
Returns a date several workdays after the start date.

[startDate] is the start date you specify.
[numDays] is the number of workdays after the start date you specify, expressed as a positive number. For example, the number "1" represents a date one workday after the start date;
[holidays] Is not required. It is specific dates that you want to remove from your calendar, such as a holiday. The input format is "yyyy-mm-dd", and multiple dates are separated by commas.

The workdays of this function do not include weekends and specific days that you specify.
en-US.function_xor_summary: Returns true if an odd number of arguments are true.
en-US.function_year_summary: Returns the four-digit year of a datetime.

en-US.lark_app_desc:
After installing the integration, please complete the space bundle, and after bundling, your team can use Vikadata on Lark.

With Vikadata Assistant on Lark, you can:

  • Access Vikadata's space and access space data directly on Lark without logging in;
  • Receive notifications from the space through Lark;
  • Set app visibility on Lark and automatically sync Lark's organization structure;
en-US.lark_app_intro: Allow you to log in to vikadata through Lark, receive your Space's notifications in Lark, and sync organizational chart from Lark

en-US.lark_integration_step1_content:
• Bind the current space to Lark, the original data can be retained intact
  • Access the vikadata space directly from the Lark Workbench to enable password-free login and access to space data
  • Receive member notifications and comment notifications from vikadata right on Lark to stay on top of space developments
  • Lark and vikadata dual-site contacts are automatically updated/synchronized, and vikadata maintains the same organizational structure as Lark
en-US.lark_integration_step1_instructions: vikadata x Lark Self-Built Application Integration Instructions
en-US.lark_integration_step1_tips_content: • In addition to the build-your-own app approach, we also offer a version of the Lark Store app that is ready to use right out of the box without configuration and binding to the space What's different?
en-US.lark_integration_step1_warning:
• Operators must have administrative access to both vikadata space and Lark

    The operator needs to be the main administrator of the space and also have the permission to create self-built applications in the Lark administration backend

  • The original members of the space will be removed from the space station, and then the member information and department information will be synchronized from the Lark side in one direction

    After Lark integration is enabled, member and department information will be based on the Lark side, so the original member/group information cannot be retained, and related permission information (sub-administrator permission, file node permission, column permission, etc.) will be lost, so please let administrators know and make preparations

en-US.test_function_modal_info_robot:
Vika Automation are the guardians for your work efficiency on the Vika Planet. Human beings are meant to do more creative things! View documentation

Example Automations:

  • Automation Alpha: When a record is created, Alpha will automatically send a message to the Slack channel
  • Automation Beta: When a specific form is submitted, Beta will automatically send a message to the Lark chat group
  • Automation Delta: when a record meets a specific condition, Delta will automatically update another record in another datasheet
en-US.test_function_modal_info_view_manual_sav:
Conflicts often arise when members modify filtering, grouping, or sorting in the same view, as each wants to configure it to suit their needs. After enabling this feature, temporary view configuration is supported in "Datasheet" and "Mirror" to reduce conflicts.

After this feature is enabled, it affects:

  • After members in "View" modify the view configuration, it will only take effect temporarily for themselves. After refreshing, the default configuration will be restored. Members can choose to manually save the view configuration and sync it to other members
  • Temporary view configurations are also supported on Mirror. Special case: The filter conditions of the source datasheet view cannot be modified in the mirror
  • Users with "read-only" permission are also allowed to temporarily modify the view configuration.
  • View configuration includes: filter, group, sort, hide fields, style, layout, field order, statistics, etc.
en-US.test_function_modal_info_widget:
As vikadata is essentially a visualized database, the widget is the best helper to quickly turn the database into different applications. Now, vikadata supports custom widgets, allowing developers to make full use of widget SDK to develop widgets that meet business scenarios and personal needs. See documentation

Examples of custom widgets:

  • Cell viewer: help you easily browse data from different column types, such as One-way Link, Two-way Link, Lookup, and Attachments
  • Vika map: help you quickly render the addresses from a datasheet in a Google map
  • URL preview: help you preview the webpage content from a URL

es-ES.ai_api_python_template:
## Initialize SDK [![github]({{ githubIcon }})](https://github.com/openai/openai-python)

AITable's chat completion API is compatible with OpenAI's Python SDK. You can use our service with the same SDK by simply changing the configuration as follows:

```python
import openai
# Setup parameters
openai.api_key = "{{token}}"
openai.api_base = "{{apiBase}}/fusion/v1/ai/{{aiId}}"
```

## Create chat completions

```python
chat_completion = openai.ChatCompletion.create(model="gpt-3.5-turbo", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello world"}])
```

## Returned data example

```python

{
  "id": "aitable_ai_CkZH2zQokhry31j_1693452659",
  "conversation id": "CS-0253eb8d-d6c6-4543-88d4-fcb555f52982",
  "actions": null,
  "object": "chat.completion",
  "created": 1693452659,
  "model":"gpt-3.5-turbo",
  "choices": [{
    "index": 0,
    "message": {
      "role": "assistant",
      "content": "\n\nHello there, how may I assist you today",
    },
    "finish_reason": "stop"
  }],
  "usage": {
    "prompt_tokens": 9,
    "completion_tokens": 12,
    "total_tokens": 21,
    "total cost": 7.900000000000001e-05,
    "result": "I am an AI, specifically a language model developed by OpenAI."
  }
}
```

## Get records

```shell
curl "{{ apiBase }}/fusion/v1/datasheets/{{ datasheetId }}/records?viewId={{ viewId }}&fieldKey={{ fieldKey }}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{ apiToken }}"

```

### Returned data example

```json

{{ response }}

```

### Other parameters and tips
```js
/**
* Note: The maximum concurrent access to data for each APITable is limited to 5 times per second
* All configurable parameters can be sent through URL Query Params,
*/
{
  /**
   * (Optional) View ID. Defaults to the first view in the APITable. The request will return the filtered/sorted results in the view, and you can use the fields parameter to filter unnecessary field data
   */
  viewId: 'viewId1',
  /**
   * (Optional) Specifies the page number of the pagination, which is 1 by default and is used in conjunction with the parameter pageSize.
   */
  pageNum: 1,
  /**
   * (Optional) Specify the total number of records returned per page, default is 100. This parameter only accepts integers from 1-1000.
   */
  pageSize: 100,
  /**
   * (Optional) Sorts the records of the specified dimensional table. An array of "sort objects". Supported order: 'asc' and reverse order: 'desc'. Note: The sorting criteria specified by this parameter will override the sorting criteria in the view.
   */
  sort: [{ field: 'field1', order: 'asc' }],
  /**
   * (Optional) An array of recordIds. If this parameter is attached, returns the records array specified in the parameter. The return values are sorted in the order of the passed array. Filtering and sorting are ignored at this time. No pagination, up to 1000 records can be queried each time
   */
  recordIds: ['recordId1', 'recordId2'],
  /**
   * (Optional) Specify the field to return (the default is the field name, and it can also be specified as the field Id by fieldKey). If this parameter is attached, the returned record collection will be filtered, and only the specified fields will be returned.
   */
  fields: ['title', 'detail', 'Number of references'],
  /**
   * (Optional) Use formulas as filter conditions to return matching records. Visit https://help.aitable.ai/docs/guide/tutorial-getting-started-with-formulas to learn how to use formulas
   */
  filterByFormula: '{Number of references} >  0',
  /**
   * (Optional) Limit the total number of records returned. If this value is less than the actual total number of records in the table, the total number of records returned will be limited to this value.
   */
  maxRecords: 5000,
  /**
   * (Optional) Cell value type, the default is 'json', when 'string' is specified, all values will be automatically converted to string format.
   */
  cellFormat: 'json',
  /**
   * (Optional) Specifies the query of the field and the returned key. By default the column name 'name' is used. When specified as 'id', fieldId will be used as the query and return method (using id can avoid the problem of code failure caused by the modification of the column name)
   */
  fieldKey: 'name',
}
```

<!--split-->

## Add records
```shell
curl -X POST "{{ apiBase }}/fusion/v1/datasheets/{{ datasheetId }}/records?viewId={{ viewId }}&fieldKey={{ fieldKey }}"  \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{ apiToken }}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{
  "records": {{ records }},
  "fieldKey": "{{ fieldKey }}"
}'

```

### Returned data example

```json
{{ response }}
```

### Other parameters and tips

The add interface receives an array value, and can create multiple records at the same time, and a single request can create up to 10 records

<!--split-->

## Update records
```shell
curl -X PATCH "{{ apiBase }}/fusion/v1/datasheets/{{ datasheetId }}/records?viewId={{ viewId }}&fieldKey={{ fieldKey }}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{ apiToken }}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{
  "records": {{ records }},
  "fieldKey": "{{ fieldKey }}"
}'
```
### Returned data example

```json
{{ response }}
```


### Other parameters and tips

The update interface receives an array value, which can update multiple records at the same time, and a single request can update up to 10 records
Special attention: update will only update the data under the fields you passed in, and will not affect the data that is not passed in. If you need to clear the value, please pass in null explicitly


<!--split-->

## Delete records
```shell
curl -X DELETE "{{ apiBase }}/fusion/v1/datasheets/{{ datasheetId }}/records?{{ deleteParams }}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{ apiToken }}"

```

### Returned data example
```json
{
  "code": 200,
  "success": true,
  "message": "success"
}
```

### Other parameters and tips

The delete interface receives an array value, which can delete multiple records at the same time, and a single request can delete up to 10 records
<!--split-->

## Upload attachments

```shell
curl -X POST "{{ apiBase }}/fusion/v1/datasheets/{{ datasheetId }}/attachments" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{ apiToken }}" \
  -H "Content-Type: multipart/form-data" \
  -F "file=@{your file path};"
```

## Initialize SDK [![github]({{ githubIcon }})](https://github.com/apitable/apitable-sdks)

```python
from apitable import Apitable
apitable = Apitable("{{ apiToken }}")
datasheet = apitable.datasheet("{{ datasheetId }}", field_key="{{ fieldKey }}")
```

{{ fieldNameTips }}
<!--split-->

## Get records

```python
# Returns all records
records = datasheet.records.all()
for record in records:
  print(record.json())

# Returns the records from a specific view
records_via_view = datasheet.records.all(viewId="{{ viewId }}")
# Get one record (if there are more than one records in the result, return the first record); It's recommended to get one record by its recordId.
one_record = datasheet.records.get({{ pyGetParams }})
# Returns the records that matches the given condition. If you don't give any condition, it returns all records.
records = datasheet.records.filter({{ pyGetParams }})
```
<!--split-->

## Add records
```python
# Add one record
row = datasheet.records.create({{ addParams }})
# Add multiple records
records = datasheet.records.bulk_create({{  bulkAddParams }})

```
<!--split-->

## Update records
```python
row = datasheet.records.get({{ pyGetParams }})

# Update one record
row.{{ oneFieldKey }} = {{ oneFieldValue }}
## row.save()

# Update multiple records
row.update({{ updateParams }})

```
<!--split-->

## Delete records
```python
record = datasheet.records.get({{ pyGetParams }})
# Delete one record
record.delete()
# Delete the records that matches a specific condition
datasheet.records.filter({{ pyGetParams }}).delete()
# Delete the records by recordIds
datasheet.delete_records({{ recordIds }})
```
<!--split-->

## Upload attachments

```python
_file = datasheet.upload_file(<local/web_filepath>)
record.{{ attachFieldName }} = [_file]
```

es-ES.function_countif_summary:
Count the number of keyword occurrences in values. 

Values: specify where to find the data from. Supports data of array type or text type. 
Keyword: the keyword to be looked up and counted. 
Operation: comparator, not required. You can fill in the condition symbols greater than ">", less than "<", equal to "=", not equal to "! =", if not filled in the default is equal to. 
Example 1 does not fill in the comparison character, the default count is equal to the number of times the value of "A" appears. 
Example 2 is filled with the comparator ">", which means that the number of occurrences of values greater than "2" is counted. 

Usage scenarios. 
1) You can count the number of occurrences of the character "A" in a string of text arrays [A, B, C, D, A] as 2, see example 1. 
2) You can count the number of numbers greater than 3 in an array of numbers [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] as 2, see example 2. 
3) You can count the number of occurrences of "grape" in a string of text "eat grapes without spitting out the skin" as 2, see example 3.

es-ES.lark_app_desc:
After installing the integration, please complete the space bundle, and after bundling, your team can use Vikadata on Lark.

With Vikadata Assistant on Lark, you can:

  • Access Vikadata's space and access space data directly on Lark without logging in;
  • Receive notifications from the space through Lark;
  • Set app visibility on Lark and automatically sync Lark's organization structure;

es-ES.lark_integration_step1_content:
• Bind the current space to Lark, the original data can be retained intact
  • Access the vikadata space directly from the Lark Workbench to enable password-free login and access to space data
  • Receive member notifications and comment notifications from vikadata right on Lark to stay on top of space developments
  • Lark and vikadata dual-site contacts are automatically updated/synchronized, and vikadata maintains the same organizational structure as Lark
es-ES.lark_integration_step1_instructions: Instrucciones de integración de aplicaciones autoconstruidas de vigadata x Lark
es-ES.lark_integration_step1_tips_content: • In addition to the build-your-own app approach, we also offer a version of the Lark Store app that is ready to use right out of the box without configuration and binding to the space What's different?
es-ES.lark_integration_step1_warning:
• Operators must have administrative access to both vikadata space and Lark

    The operator needs to be the main administrator of the space and also have the permission to create self-built applications in the Lark administration backend

  • The original members of the space will be removed from the space station, and then the member information and department information will be synchronized from the Lark side in one direction

    After Lark integration is enabled, member and department information will be based on the Lark side, so the original member/group information cannot be retained, and related permission information (sub-administrator permission, file permission, column permission, etc.) will be lost, so please let administrators know and make preparations

es-ES.office_preview_app_desc:
Smooth online preview of office files on datasheet, allowing you to view common office files such as Excel, Word, PPT, etc. on your desktop or mobile anywhere, anytime

  • Online preview of .doc, .docx, .xls, .xlsx, .ppt, .pptx, and .pdf formatted office files
  • Desktop and mobile both support file previews of the above formats

Additional notes:

  • This feature is powered by "Yoncentric Cloud Conversion" and officially integrated
  • Click the "Enable" button below to enable this integration and agree that "Yoncentric Cloud Conversion" reads the office files you want to preview
  • If you no longer need the office files preview feature, the space admin can disable it on this page

Vika Automation son los guardianes de la eficiencia de su trabajo en Vika Planet. ¡Los seres humanos están destinados a hacer cosas más creativas! Ver documentación

Ejemplos de automatizaciones:

  • Automatización Alpha: cuando se crea un registro, Alpha enviará automáticamente un mensaje al canal de Slack.
  • Beta de automatización: cuando se envía un formulario específico, Beta enviará automáticamente un mensaje al grupo de chat de Lark.
  • Delta de automatización: cuando un registro cumple con una condición específica, Delta actualizará automáticamente otro registro en otra hoja de datos
es-ES.test_function_modal_info_view_manual_sav:
Conflicts often arise when members modify filtering, grouping, or sorting in the same view, as each wants to configure it to suit their needs. After enabling this feature, temporary view configuration is supported in "Datasheet" and "Mirror" to reduce conflicts.

After this feature is enabled, it affects:

  • After members in "View" modify the view configuration, it will only take effect temporarily for themselves. After refreshing, the default configuration will be restored. Members can choose to manually save the view configuration and sync it to other members
  • Temporary view configurations are also supported on Mirror. Special case: The filter conditions of the source datasheet view cannot be modified in the mirror
  • Users with "read-only" permission are also allowed to temporarily modify the view configuration.
  • View configuration includes: filter, group, sort, hide fields, style, layout, field order, statistics, etc.
es-ES.test_function_modal_info_widget:
Como vikadata es esencialmente una base de datos visualizada, el widget es el mejor ayudante para convertir rápidamente la base de datos en diferentes aplicaciones. Ahora, vikadata soporta widgets personalizados, lo que permite a los desarrolladores hacer pleno uso del widget SDK para desarrollar widgets que satisfagan los escenarios de negocio y las necesidades personales. fr-FR.ai_api_python_template:
## Initialize SDK [![github]({{ githubIcon }})](https://github.com/openai/openai-python)

AITable's chat completion API is compatible with OpenAI's Python SDK. You can use our service with the same SDK by simply changing the configuration as follows:

```python
import openai
# Setup parameters
openai.api_key = "{{token}}"
openai.api_base = "{{apiBase}}/fusion/v1/ai/{{aiId}}"
```

## Create chat completions

```python
chat_completion = openai.ChatCompletion.create(model="gpt-3.5-turbo", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello world"}])
```

## Returned data example

```python

{
  "id": "aitable_ai_CkZH2zQokhry31j_1693452659",
  "conversation id": "CS-0253eb8d-d6c6-4543-88d4-fcb555f52982",
  "actions": null,
  "object": "chat.completion",
  "created": 1693452659,
  "model":"gpt-3.5-turbo",
  "choices": [{
    "index": 0,
    "message": {
      "role": "assistant",
      "content": "\n\nHello there, how may I assist you today",
    },
    "finish_reason": "stop"
  }],
  "usage": {
    "prompt_tokens": 9,
    "completion_tokens": 12,
    "total_tokens": 21,
    "total cost": 7.900000000000001e-05,
    "result": "I am an AI, specifically a language model developed by OpenAI."
  }
}
```

## Get records

```shell
curl "{{ apiBase }}/fusion/v1/datasheets/{{ datasheetId }}/records?viewId={{ viewId }}&fieldKey={{ fieldKey }}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{ apiToken }}"

```

### Returned data example

```json

{{ response }}

```

### Other parameters and tips
```js
/**
* Note: The maximum concurrent access to data for each APITable is limited to 5 times per second
* All configurable parameters can be sent through URL Query Params,
*/
{
  /**
   * (Optional) View ID. Defaults to the first view in the APITable. The request will return the filtered/sorted results in the view, and you can use the fields parameter to filter unnecessary field data
   */
  viewId: 'viewId1',
  /**
   * (Optional) Specifies the page number of the pagination, which is 1 by default and is used in conjunction with the parameter pageSize.
   */
  pageNum: 1,
  /**
   * (Optional) Specify the total number of records returned per page, default is 100. This parameter only accepts integers from 1-1000.
   */
  pageSize: 100,
  /**
   * (Optional) Sorts the records of the specified dimensional table. An array of "sort objects". Supported order: 'asc' and reverse order: 'desc'. Note: The sorting criteria specified by this parameter will override the sorting criteria in the view.
   */
  sort: [{ field: 'field1', order: 'asc' }],
  /**
   * (Optional) An array of recordIds. If this parameter is attached, returns the records array specified in the parameter. The return values are sorted in the order of the passed array. Filtering and sorting are ignored at this time. No pagination, up to 1000 records can be queried each time
   */
  recordIds: ['recordId1', 'recordId2'],
  /**
   * (Optional) Specify the field to return (the default is the field name, and it can also be specified as the field Id by fieldKey). If this parameter is attached, the returned record collection will be filtered, and only the specified fields will be returned.
   */
  fields: ['title', 'detail', 'Number of references'],
  /**
   * (Optional) Use formulas as filter conditions to return matching records. Visit https://help.aitable.ai/docs/guide/tutorial-getting-started-with-formulas to learn how to use formulas
   */
  filterByFormula: '{Number of references} >  0',
  /**

   */

   */
  fieldKey: 'name',
}
```

```shell
curl -X POST "{{ apiBase }}/fusion/v1/datasheets/{{ datasheetId }}/records?viewId={{ viewId }}&fieldKey={{ fieldKey }}"  \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{ apiToken }}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \

  "records": {{ records }},
  "fieldKey": "{{ fieldKey }}"
}'

```

```shell
curl -X PATCH "{{ apiBase }}/fusion/v1/datasheets/{{ datasheetId }}/records?viewId={{ viewId }}&fieldKey={{ fieldKey }}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{ apiToken }}" \
```

fr-FR.create_mirror_guide_content:
La fonction miroir a la capacité de masquer certaines données. Vous pouvez définir des "conditions de filtre" et des "champs masqués" dans la vue de feuille de données d'origine pour contrôler les enregistrements et les champs affichés dans le miroir.
</br>
</br>
S'il est utilisé en conjonction avec la fonction "verrouiller la vue", il peut empêcher les autres d'apporter des modifications.
</br>
</br>
De plus, vous pouvez aller dans "Table d'origine>Champs cachés" pour modifier la configuration pour "Afficher tous les champs dans les miroirs".

fr-FR.dingtalk_app_desc:
Après avoir installé l'intégration, veuillez compléter le pack d'espace, et après le regroupement, votre équipe peut utiliser Vikadata sur DingTalk.

Avec l'Assistant Vikadata sur DingTalk, vous pouvez :

  • Accéder à l'espace de Vikadata et accéder aux données d'espace directement sur DingTalk sans vous connecter;
  • Recevoir des notifications de l'espace via DingTalk ;
  • Définissez la visibilité de l'application sur DingTalk et synchronisez automatiquement la structure organisationnelle de DingTalk ;
fr-FR.dingtalk_app_intro: Vous permet de vous connecter à vikadata par l'intermédiaire de DingTalk, de recevoir les notifications de votre espace dans DingTalk, et de synchroniser le graphique organisationnel de DingTalk

fr-FR.function_countif_summary:
Compter le nombre d'occurrences de mots-clés dans les valeurs. 

Valeurs : spécifiez d'où trouver les données. Supporte les données de type tableau ou de type texte. 
Mot-clé : le mot clé à rechercher et à compter. 
Opération: comparateur, non requis. Vous pouvez remplir les symboles de condition plus grands que ">", inférieur à "<", égal à "=", et non égal à "! =", s'il n'est pas renseigné dans la valeur par défaut est égal. 
L'exemple 1 ne remplit pas le caractère de comparaison, le nombre par défaut est égal au nombre de fois que la valeur de "A" apparaît. 
L'exemple 2 est rempli avec le comparateur ">", ce qui signifie que le nombre d'occurrences de valeurs supérieures à "2" est compté. 

Scénarios d'utilisation. 
1) Vous pouvez compter le nombre d'occurrences du caractère "A" dans une chaîne de tableaux de texte [A, B, C, D, A] comme 2, voir l'exemple 1. 
2) Vous pouvez compter le nombre de nombres supérieurs à 3 dans un tableau de nombres [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] comme 2, voir l'exemple 2. 
3) Vous pouvez compter le nombre d'occurrences de "raisin" dans une chaîne de texte "manger du raisin sans cracher la peau" comme 2, voir l'exemple 3.

Similaire à FIND(), bien que FIND() renvoie 0 plutôt que vide si aucune occurrence de stringToFind n'est trouvée.

fr-FR.function_substitute_summary:
Remplace les occurrences de old_text par new_text.
Vous pouvez éventuellement spécifier un numéro d'index (à partir de 1) pour remplacer juste une occurrence spécifique de old_text. Si aucun numéro d'index n'est spécifié, toutes les occurrences de old_text seront remplacées.
fr-FR.function_sum_summary: Somme ensemble des nombres. Équivalent au numéro 1 + numéro2 + ...
fr-FR.function_switch_summary: Prend une expression, une liste de valeurs possibles pour cette expression, et pour chacune, une valeur que l'expression doit prendre dans ce cas. Il peut également prendre une valeur par défaut si la saisie de l'expression ne correspond à aucun des modèles définis. Dans de nombreux cas, SWITCH() peut être utilisé à la place d'une formule IF() imbriquée.
fr-FR.function_t_summary: Retourne l'argument s'il est du texte et vide autrement.
fr-FR.function_timestr_summary: Formate une datetime en une chaîne temporelle (HH:mm:ss).
fr-FR.function_today_summary:
Renvoie la date d'aujourd'hui (année, mois et jour), mais n'est pas précise aux heures, minutes et secondes (par défaut 00:00:00). Si vous voulez être précis sur les heures, les minutes et les secondes, utilisez la fonction MAINTENANT.

Remarque : Les résultats retournés par cette fonction ne sont mis à jour que lorsque la formule de calcul est actualisée ou que la feuille de données est actualisée.
fr-FR.function_tonow_summary: Calcule le nombre de jours entre la date courante et une autre date.
fr-FR.function_trim_summary: Supprime les espaces au début et à la fin de la chaîne.
fr-FR.function_validate_params_count_at_least: La fonction ${name} nécessite au moins ${count} paramètres
fr-FR.function_value_summary: Convertit la chaîne de texte en un nombre.
fr-FR.function_weekday_summary:
Retourne le jour de la semaine, sous la forme d'un entier compris entre 0 et 6. Vous pouvez éventuellement fournir un deuxième argument (soit "dimanche" ou "lundi") pour commencer des semaines ce jour-là. Si omis, les semaines commencent le dimanche par défaut. Exemple:
WEEKDAY(TODAY(), "Lundi")
fr-FR.function_weeknum_summary:
Renvoie le numéro de la semaine dans une année. Vous pouvez éventuellement fournir un deuxième argument (soit "Dimanche" ou "Lundi") pour commencer les semaines ce jour-là. Si omis, les semaines commencent le dimanche par défaut. Exemple:
WEEKNUM(TODAY(), "Lundi")
fr-FR.function_workday_diff_summary: Renvoie le nombre de jours ouvrables entre la date de début et la date de fin. Les jours de travail excluent les week-ends et une liste optionnelle de jours fériés, formatés comme une chaîne séparée par des virgules de dates au format ISO.
fr-FR.function_workday_summary:
Renvoie une date plusieurs jours ouvrables après la date de début.

[startDate] est la date de début que vous spécifiez.
[numDays] est le nombre de jours de travail après la date de début que vous spécifiez, exprimé comme un nombre positif. Par exemple, le nombre "1" représente une date un jour ouvrable après la date de début ;
[holidays] n'est pas obligatoire. Ce sont des dates précises que vous souhaitez retirer de votre calendrier, comme un jour férié. Le format d'entrée est "yyyy-mm-dd", et plusieurs dates sont séparées par des virgules.

Les jours ouvrables de cette fonction n'incluent pas les week-ends et les jours spécifiques que vous spécifiez.
fr-FR.function_xor_summary: Retourne vrai si un nombre impair d'arguments est vrai.
fr-FR.function_year_summary: Renvoie l'année à quatre chiffres d'une date et d'une heure.

fr-FR.lark_app_desc:
Après avoir installé l'intégration, veuillez compléter le pack d'espace, et après le bundle, votre équipe peut utiliser Vikadata sur Lark.

Avec l'Assistant Vikadata sur Lark, vous pouvez :

  • Accéder à l'espace de Vikadata et accéder aux données d'espace directement sur Lark sans vous connecter;
  • Recevoir des notifications de l'espace via Lark ;
  • Définissez la visibilité de l'application sur Lark et synchronisez automatiquement la structure organisationnelle de Lark ;

  • Accédez à l'espace vikadata directement depuis l'établi de Lark pour permettre la connexion sans mot de passe et l'accès aux données spatiales

fr-FR.lark_integration_step1_tips_content: • En plus de l'approche de la construction de votre propre application, nous offrons également une version de l'application Lark Store qui est prête à être utilisée sans configuration et sans liaison avec l'espace Quoi de différent ?
fr-FR.lark_integration_step1_warning:
• Les opérateurs doivent avoir un accès administratif à l'espace vikadonnées et à l'espace Lark

    L'opérateur doit être l'administrateur principal de l'espace et avoir également la permission de créer des applications auto-construites dans le backend d'administration de Lark

  • Les membres d'origine de l'espace seront retirés de la station spatiale, puis les informations des membres et du service seront synchronisées depuis le côté Lark dans une direction

    Après l'intégration de Lark est activé, les informations du membre et du service seront basées sur le côté du Lark, donc les informations du membre / groupe ne peuvent pas être conservées, et les informations de permission connexes (permission de sous-administrateur, permission de fichier, permission de colonne, etc.) va être perdu, donc veuillez informer les administrateurs et faire des préparatifs

fr-FR.office_preview_app_desc:
Aperçu en ligne lisse des fichiers bureautiques sur la feuille de données, vous permettant de visualiser les fichiers bureautiques courants tels que Excel, Word, PPT, etc. sur votre ordinateur de bureau ou mobile n'importe où, à tout moment

  • Aperçu en ligne de . oc, .docx, .xls, .xlsx, .ppt, .pptx, et . df fichiers bureautiques formatés
  • Bureau et mobile supportent les aperçus de fichiers des formats ci-dessus

Notes supplémentaires :

  • Cette fonctionnalité est alimentée par "Conversion Cloud Yoncentrique" et officiellement intégrée
  • Cliquez sur le bouton "Activer" ci-dessous pour activer cette intégration et accepter que "Conversion Cloud Yoncentrique" lit les fichiers bureautiques que vous souhaitez prévisualiser
  • Si vous n'avez plus besoin de la fonction de prévisualisation des fichiers bureautiques, l'administrateur de l'espace peut le désactiver sur cette page
fr-FR.office_preview_app_intro: Avec cette intégration, vous pouvez facilement prévisualiser les fichiers Microsoft Office dans les champs "Pièces jointes"
fr-FR.office_preview_app_notice: * Remarque : Cliquer sur "activer" signifie que vous acceptez d'autoriser le fournisseur de services à lire vos fichiers Office

fr-FR.test_function_modal_info_robot:
Vika Automation est le gardien de l'efficacité de votre travail sur la planète Vika. Les êtres humains sont censés faire des choses plus créatives ! Afficher la documentation

Exemples d'automatisations :

  • Automation Alpha : lorsqu'un enregistrement est créé, Alpha enverra automatiquement un message au canal Slack
  • Bêta d'automatisation : lorsqu'un formulaire spécifique est soumis, la version bêta enverra automatiquement un message au groupe de discussion Lark.
  • Automation Delta : lorsqu'un enregistrement répond à une condition spécifique, Delta mettra automatiquement à jour un autre enregistrement dans une autre feuille de données
fr-FR.test_function_modal_info_view_manual_sav:
Des conflits surviennent souvent lorsque des membres modifient le filtrage, le regroupement, ou trier dans la même vue, que chacun veut le configurer pour qu'il réponde à ses besoins. Après avoir activé cette fonctionnalité, la configuration de la vue temporaire est prise en charge dans "Feuille de données" et "Mirror" pour réduire les conflits.

Après que cette fonctionnalité soit activée, cela affecte :

  • Après les membres dans "Voir" modifier la configuration de la vue, elle n'entrera en vigueur que temporairement. Après rafraîchissement, la configuration par défaut sera restaurée. Les membres peuvent choisir d'enregistrer manuellement la configuration de la vue et de la synchroniser avec d'autres membres
  • Les configurations de vue temporaire sont également prises en charge sur Mirror. Cas spécial : Les conditions de filtre de la vue de la feuille de données source ne peuvent pas être modifiées dans le miroir
  • Les utilisateurs ayant la permission "read-only" sont également autorisés à modifier temporairement la configuration de la vue.
  • La configuration de la vue comprend : filtre, groupe, tri, masquer les champs, style, mise en page, ordre de terrain, statistiques, etc.
fr-FR.test_function_modal_info_widget:
< P > comme vikadata est essentiellement une base de données visualisée, le widget est la meilleure aide pour transformer rapidement la base de données en différentes applications. Maintenant, vikadata prend en charge les widgets personnalisés, permettant aux développeurs d'utiliser pleinement le SDK de widget pour développer des widgets qui répondent à des scénarios d'affaires et à des besoins personnels. < a href = "https: / / vika.cn / developers / widget / introduction" target = "_ blank" > voir documentation < / a > < / P >

< P > exemples de widgets personnalisés: < / P >

< Li > Vika map: vous aider à afficher rapidement les adresses d'une feuille de données dans une carte Google < / Li >

< Li > URL Preview: vous aider à prévisualiser le contenu de la page Web à partir d'une URL < / Li > < / ul >

## Initialize SDK [![github]({{ githubIcon }})](https://github.com/openai/openai-python)

AITable's chat completion API is compatible with OpenAI's Python SDK. You can use our service with the same SDK by simply changing the configuration as follows:

```python
import openai
# Setup parameters
openai.api_key = "{{token}}"
openai.api_base = "{{apiBase}}/fusion/v1/ai/{{aiId}}"
```

## Create chat completions

```python
chat_completion = openai.ChatCompletion.create(model="gpt-3.5-turbo", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello world"}])
```

## Get records

```shell
curl "{{ apiBase }}/fusion/v1/datasheets/{{ datasheetId }}/records?viewId={{ viewId }}&fieldKey={{ fieldKey }}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{ apiToken }}"

```

### Returned data example

```json

{{ response }}

```

### Other parameters and tips
```js
/**
* Note: The maximum concurrent access to data for each APITable is limited to 5 times per second
* All configurable parameters can be sent through URL Query Params,
*/
{
  /**
   * (Optional) View ID. Defaults to the first view in the APITable. The request will return the filtered/sorted results in the view, and you can use the fields parameter to filter unnecessary field data
   */
  viewId: 'viewId1',
  /**
   * (Optional) Specifies the page number of the pagination, which is 1 by default and is used in conjunction with the parameter pageSize.
   */
  pageNum: 1,
  /**
   * (Optional) Specify the total number of records returned per page, default is 100. This parameter only accepts integers from 1-1000.
   */
  pageSize: 100,
  /**
   * (Optional) Sorts the records of the specified dimensional table. An array of "sort objects". Supported order: 'asc' and reverse order: 'desc'. Note: The sorting criteria specified by this parameter will override the sorting criteria in the view.
   */
  sort: [{ field: 'field1', order: 'asc' }],
  /**
   * (Optional) An array of recordIds. If this parameter is attached, returns the records array specified in the parameter. The return values are sorted in the order of the passed array. Filtering and sorting are ignored at this time. No pagination, up to 1000 records can be queried each time
   */
  recordIds: ['recordId1', 'recordId2'],
  /**
   * (Optional) Specify the field to return (the default is the field name, and it can also be specified as the field Id by fieldKey). If this parameter is attached, the returned record collection will be filtered, and only the specified fields will be returned.
   */
  fields: ['title', 'detail', 'Number of references'],
  /**
   * (Optional) Use formulas as filter conditions to return matching records. Visit https://help.aitable.ai/docs/guide/tutorial-getting-started-with-formulas to learn how to use formulas
   */
  filterByFormula: '{Number of references} >  0',
  /**
   * (Optional) Limit the total number of records returned. If this value is less than the actual total number of records in the table, the total number of records returned will be limited to this value.
   */
  maxRecords: 5000,
  /**
   * (Optional) Cell value type, the default is 'json', when 'string' is specified, all values will be automatically converted to string format.
   */
  cellFormat: 'json',
  /**
   * (Optional) Specifies the query of the field and the returned key. By default the column name 'name' is used. When specified as 'id', fieldId will be used as the query and return method (using id can avoid the problem of code failure caused by the modification of the column name)
   */
  fieldKey: 'name',
}
```

<!--split-->

## Add records
```shell
curl -X POST "{{ apiBase }}/fusion/v1/datasheets/{{ datasheetId }}/records?viewId={{ viewId }}&fieldKey={{ fieldKey }}"  \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{ apiToken }}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{
  "records": {{ records }},
  "fieldKey": "{{ fieldKey }}"
}'

```

### Returned data example

```json
{{ response }}
```

### Other parameters and tips

The add interface receives an array value, and can create multiple records at the same time, and a single request can create up to 10 records

<!--split-->

## Update records
```shell
curl -X PATCH "{{ apiBase }}/fusion/v1/datasheets/{{ datasheetId }}/records?viewId={{ viewId }}&fieldKey={{ fieldKey }}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{ apiToken }}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{
  "records": {{ records }},
  "fieldKey": "{{ fieldKey }}"
}'
```
### Returned data example

```json
{{ response }}
```


### Other parameters and tips

The update interface receives an array value, which can update multiple records at the same time, and a single request can update up to 10 records
Special attention: update will only update the data under the fields you passed in, and will not affect the data that is not passed in. If you need to clear the value, please pass in null explicitly


<!--split-->

## Delete records
```shell
curl -X DELETE "{{ apiBase }}/fusion/v1/datasheets/{{ datasheetId }}/records?{{ deleteParams }}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{ apiToken }}"

```

### Returned data example
```json
{
  "code": 200,
  "success": true,
  "message": "success"
}
```

### Other parameters and tips

The delete interface receives an array value, which can delete multiple records at the same time, and a single request can delete up to 10 records

```shell
curl -X POST "{{ apiBase }}/fusion/v1/datasheets/{{ datasheetId }}/attachments" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{ apiToken }}" \
  -H "Content-Type: multipart/form-data" \
  -F "file=@{your file path};"
```

## Initialize SDK [![github]({{ githubIcon }})](https://github.com/apitable/apitable-sdks)

```python
from apitable import Apitable
apitable = Apitable("{{ apiToken }}")
datasheet = apitable.datasheet("{{ datasheetId }}", field_key="{{ fieldKey }}")
```

{{ fieldNameTips }}
<!--split-->

## Get records

```python
# Returns all records
records = datasheet.records.all()
for record in records:
  print(record.json())

# Returns the records from a specific view
records_via_view = datasheet.records.all(viewId="{{ viewId }}")
# Get one record (if there are more than one records in the result, return the first record); It's recommended to get one record by its recordId.
one_record = datasheet.records.get({{ pyGetParams }})
# Returns the records that matches the given condition. If you don't give any condition, it returns all records.
records = datasheet.records.filter({{ pyGetParams }})
```
<!--split-->

## Add records
```python
# Add one record
row = datasheet.records.create({{ addParams }})
# Add multiple records
records = datasheet.records.bulk_create({{  bulkAddParams }})

```
<!--split-->

## Update records
```python
row = datasheet.records.get({{ pyGetParams }})

# Update one record
row.{{ oneFieldKey }} = {{ oneFieldValue }}
## row.save()

# Update multiple records
row.update({{ updateParams }})

```
<!--split-->

## Delete records
```python
record = datasheet.records.get({{ pyGetParams }})
# Delete one record
record.delete()
# Delete the records that matches a specific condition
datasheet.records.filter({{ pyGetParams }}).delete()
# Delete the records by recordIds
datasheet.delete_records({{ recordIds }})
```
<!--split-->

it-IT.api_panel_type_desc_attachment: Restituisce un array di oggetti allegati. Ogni oggetto include le seguenti proprietà: 1. mimeType (string): il tipo di supporto dell'allegato; 2. name (string): il nome dell'allegato; 3. size (number): la dimensione dell'allegato (byte); 4. larghezza (numero): larghezza dell'immagine (px), se l'allegato è un'immagine; 5. altezza (numero): l'altezza dell'immagine (px), se l'allegato è un'immagine; 6. token (stringa): il percorso di accesso dell'allegato; 7. anteprima (stringa): l'URL dell'immagine di anteprima che è possibile aprire in un browser, se l'allegato è un PDF
it-IT.api_panel_type_desc_autonumber: Restituisce un numero positivo. Il sistema genera automaticamente i numeri in modo da non poter scrivere nel campo tramite API.
it-IT.api_panel_type_desc_cascader: Restituisce le opzioni selezionate come array di stringhe
it-IT.api_panel_type_desc_checkbox: Restituisce true come formato booleano se la casella di controllo è selezionata. Altrimenti il risultato di ritorno non includerà questo campo Casella di controllo.
it-IT.api_panel_type_desc_created_by: Restituisce una matrice che contiene un oggetto unità. L'unità è il membro che crea il record. (Un'unità descrive i ruoli in uno spazio come un membro o un team. "unitType" ha due valori: 1 sta per team; 3 sta per membro.)
it-IT.api_panel_type_desc_currency: Restituisce un numero positivo o negativo. Il risultato di ritorno non includerà la precisione o il simbolo indicati nelle impostazioni del campo.
it-IT.api_panel_type_desc_email: Restituisce un indirizzo email come stringa
it-IT.api_panel_type_desc_formula: Restituisce un numero, una stringa o un risultato booleano. Il risultato della formula è calcolato dal sistema. Non è possibile scrivere nel campo Formula per API.
it-IT.api_panel_type_desc_last_modified_by: Restituisce una matrice che contiene un oggetto unità. L'unità è l'ultima unità che modifica il record o il/i campo/i specificato/i. (Un'unità descrive i ruoli in uno spazio come un membro o un team. "unitType" ha due valori: 1 sta per team; 3 sta per membro.)
it-IT.api_panel_type_desc_link: Restituisce una serie di stringhe. Ogni stringa è l'ID di un record che viene aggiunto nel campo Link.
it-IT.api_panel_type_desc_look_up: Restituisce un numero, una stringa o un array. Il risultato della ricerca viene calcolato dal sistema. Non è possibile scrivere nel campo Ricerca per API.
it-IT.api_panel_type_desc_member: Restituisce una matrice di oggetti unità. Un'unità descrive i ruoli in uno spazio come un membro o un team. "type" ha due valori: 1 sta per team; 3 sta per membro.
it-IT.api_panel_type_desc_multi_select: Restituisce le opzioni selezionate come array di stringhe
it-IT.api_panel_type_desc_number: Restituisce un numero positivo o negativo. Il risultato di ritorno non includerà la precisione o il simbolo indicati nelle impostazioni del campo.
it-IT.api_panel_type_desc_one_way_link: Restituisce una serie di stringhe. Ogni stringa è l'ID di un record che viene aggiunto nel campo One Way Link.
it-IT.api_panel_type_desc_percent: Restituisce un numero positivo o negativo. Il risultato di ritorno non includerà la precisione o il simbolo indicati nelle impostazioni del campo.
it-IT.api_panel_type_desc_phone: Restituisce un numero di telefono come stringa
it-IT.api_panel_type_desc_rating: Restituisce un numero positivo compreso tra 1 e 10. Il risultato restituito non includerà questo campo se il valore è vuoto.
it-IT.api_panel_type_desc_single_text: Restituisce una stringa senza interruzioni di riga "\n"
it-IT.api_panel_type_desc_text: Restituisce una stringa con interruzioni di riga "\n"
it-IT.api_panel_type_desc_url: Restituisce un oggetto URL, incluso titolo (titolo della pagina web), testo (indirizzo della pagina web), favicon (icona della pagina web)

</br>
</br>

</br>
</br>
Inoltre, puoi andare su "Tabella originale>Campi nascosti" per modificare la configurazione per "Mostra tutti i campi nei mirror".

it-IT.dingtalk_app_desc:
After installing the integration, please complete the space bundle, and after bundling, your team can use Vikadata on DingTalk.

With Vikadata Assistant on DingTalk, you can:

  • Access Vikadata's space and access space data directly on DingTalk without logging in;
  • Receive notifications from the space through DingTalk;
  • Set app visibility on DingTalk and automatically sync DingTalk's organization structure;

it-IT.function_countif_summary:
Count the number of keyword occurrences in values. 

Values: specify where to find the data from. Supports data of array type or text type. 
Keyword: the keyword to be looked up and counted. 
Operation: comparator, not required. You can fill in the condition symbols greater than ">", less than "<", equal to "=", not equal to "! =", if not filled in the default is equal to. 
Example 1 does not fill in the comparison character, the default count is equal to the number of times the value of "A" appears. 
Example 2 is filled with the comparator ">", which means that the number of occurrences of values greater than "2" is counted. 

Usage scenarios. 
1) You can count the number of occurrences of the character "A" in a string of text arrays [A, B, C, D, A] as 2, see example 1. 
2) You can count the number of numbers greater than 3 in an array of numbers [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] as 2, see example 2. 
3) You can count the number of occurrences of "grape" in a string of text "eat grapes without spitting out the skin" as 2, see example 3.

it-IT.function_workday_summary:

[startDate] is the start date you specify.
[numDays] is the number of workdays after the start date you specify, expressed as a positive number. For example, the number "1" represents a date one workday after the start date;
[holidays] Is not required. It is specific dates that you want to remove from your calendar, such as a holiday. The input format is "yyyy-mm-dd", and multiple dates are separated by commas.

The workdays of this function do not include weekends and specific days that you specify.

it-IT.lark_app_desc:
After installing the integration, please complete the space bundle, and after bundling, your team can use Vikadata on Lark.

With Vikadata Assistant on Lark, you can:

  • Access Vikadata's space and access space data directly on Lark without logging in;
  • Receive notifications from the space through Lark;
  • Set app visibility on Lark and automatically sync Lark's organization structure;
it-IT.lark_app_intro: Consente di accedere a vikadata tramite Lark, ricevere le notifiche del tuo spazio in Lark e sincronizzare l'organigramma da Lark

it-IT.lark_integration_step1_content:
• Bind the current space to Lark, the original data can be retained intact
  • Access the vikadata space directly from the Lark Workbench to enable password-free login and access to space data
  • Receive member notifications and comment notifications from vikadata right on Lark to stay on top of space developments
  • Lark and vikadata dual-site contacts are automatically updated/synchronized, and vikadata maintains the same organizational structure as Lark
it-IT.lark_integration_step1_instructions: vikadata x Lark Istruzioni per l'integrazione di applicazioni autocostruite
it-IT.lark_integration_step1_tips_content: • In addition to the build-your-own app approach, we also offer a version of the Lark Store app that is ready to use right out of the box without configuration and binding to the space What's different?
it-IT.lark_integration_step1_warning:
• Operators must have administrative access to both vikadata space and Lark

    The operator needs to be the main administrator of the space and also have the permission to create self-built applications in the Lark administration backend

  • The original members of the space will be removed from the space station, and then the member information and department information will be synchronized from the Lark side in one direction

    After Lark integration is enabled, member and department information will be based on the Lark side, so the original member/group information cannot be retained, and related permission information (sub-administrator permission, file permission, column permission, etc.) will be lost, so please let administrators know and make preparations

it-IT.office_preview_app_desc:
Smooth online preview of office files on datasheet, allowing you to view common office files such as Excel, Word, PPT, etc. on your desktop or mobile anywhere, anytime

  • Online preview of .doc, .docx, .xls, .xlsx, .ppt, .pptx, and .pdf formatted office files
  • Desktop and mobile both support file previews of the above formats

Additional notes:

  • This feature is powered by "Yoncentric Cloud Conversion" and officially integrated
  • Click the "Enable" button below to enable this integration and agree that "Yoncentric Cloud Conversion" reads the office files you want to preview
  • If you no longer need the office files preview feature, the space admin can disable it on this page

Vika Automation è il guardiano della tua efficienza lavorativa sul Pianeta Vika. Gli esseri umani sono destinati a fare cose più creative! Visualizza la documentazione

Automazioni di esempio:

  • Automazione Alpha: quando viene creato un record, Alpha invierà automaticamente un messaggio al canale Slack
  • Beta di automazione: quando viene inviato un modulo specifico, Beta invierà automaticamente un messaggio al gruppo di chat di Lark
  • Delta di automazione: quando un record soddisfa una condizione specifica, Delta aggiornerà automaticamente un altro record in un'altra scheda tecnica
it-IT.test_function_modal_info_view_manual_sav:
Conflicts often arise when members modify filtering, grouping, or sorting in the same view, as each wants to configure it to suit their needs. After enabling this feature, temporary view configuration is supported in "Datasheet" and "Mirror" to reduce conflicts.

After this feature is enabled, it affects:

  • After members in "View" modify the view configuration, it will only take effect temporarily for themselves. After refreshing, the default configuration will be restored. Members can choose to manually save the view configuration and sync it to other members
  • Temporary view configurations are also supported on Mirror. Special case: The filter conditions of the source datasheet view cannot be modified in the mirror
  • Users with "read-only" permission are also allowed to temporarily modify the view configuration.
  • View configuration includes: filter, group, sort, hide fields, style, layout, field order, statistics, etc.

ja-JP.ai_api_python_template:
## Initialize SDK [![github]({{ githubIcon }})](https://github.com/openai/openai-python)

AITable's chat completion API is compatible with OpenAI's Python SDK. You can use our service with the same SDK by simply changing the configuration as follows:

```python
import openai
# Setup parameters
openai.api_key = "{{token}}"
openai.api_base = "{{apiBase}}/fusion/v1/ai/{{aiId}}"
```

```python
{
```
